subdivision_of_building: This proposal is for the installation of an artificial sports pitch, not any building, therefore all questions concerning buildings are not relevant to this planning application.

description: Creation of a 3G Artificial Turf Pitch with associated features including a 3G artificial turf playing enclosure, 4.5m high and 8.0m high ball stop fencing, entrance gates, 1.2m high and 2.0m high pitch barriers with entrance gates, eight 15.0m high floodlights around the facility perimeter, hard-standing areas for pedestrian access and circulation, portable goals storage, as well as internal vehicular access
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design And Access Statement With Planning Statement, 20906 Microdrainage Lateral Drain Soak-Away 1-100+40 , D21-038 Fire Statement, Eco02741 Ecological Appraisal, King's House School Sports Ground Project Justification V2, R-Si-20564-01-01 Site Investigation Report, D21-038 Dwg 0001.00 Location Plan, D21-038 Dwg 0002.00 Existing Site Plan, D21-038 Dwg 0003.00 Proposed Site Plan, D21-038 Dwg 0004.00 Proposed Floor Plan, D21-038 Dwg 0005.00 Proposed Layout, D21-038 Dwg 0006.00 Proposed Drainage, D21-038 Dwg 0007.00 Proposed Floodlights, D21-038 Dwg 0008.00 0 proposed Elevations, D21-038 Dwg 0009.00 Proposed Elevations Received: 23/11/2022; HLS5315, Calculux Report, D21-038 DWG 0010.00 , D21-038 DWG 0011.00, D21-038 DWG 0012.00 Received: 05/01/2023; D21-038 / DWG / 0013 Received: 23/01/2023; D21-038 / DWG / 0014, D21-038 / DWG / 0015 Received: 27/01/2023; Water Management, Operation And Maintenance Plan Received: 08/03/2023; Flood Risk Assessment And Drainage Strategy R-Fra-20796-02-B Received: 27/03/2023) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The floodlighting columns hereby permitted shall not be operated outside the hours of 07:00am to 10:00pm. They shall be functional and directional and shall be designed in line with current guidance (BCT and ILP, 2018; Stone, E.L. (2013), avoiding excessive up-lighting and light spill beyond the boundaries of the pitch.

Condition : 4 - Prior to first use of the development, a completed community use agreement prepared in consultation with Sport England shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The agreement shall apply to sport facilities and ancillary provision and include details of pricing policy, hours of use, access by non-educational establishment users, management responsibilities and a mechanism for review. The development shall not be used otherwise than in strict compliance with the approved agreement.

Condition : 5 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities shall be provided for the provision of no less than 10 Sheffield stands for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development. The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 6 - No site hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and installation contracts) is submitted to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme for the site has been completed in accordance with the submitted details. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Condition : 7 - Prior to first use of the development, full details of at least three bird and three bat nesting boxes shall have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing, in accordance with the following specifications:
-	Three bat boxes, installed on suitable trees at the site at a minimum height of 3 metres, facing in a southerly direction, in an unlit location, and with connectivity to suitable habitats. 
-	Three starling 'Stumus vulgaris' nest boxes, installed within the wider sports ground site, placed at a minimum height of 3 metres, facing in a southerly direction, in an unlit location and with connectivity to suitable habitats.
The nesting boxes shall be installed strictly in accordance with the details so approved, and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 8 - Prior to first use of the development, the non-turf wickets shown on Drawing No. D21-038/DWG/0003 Rev.00 shall be installed and available for use in accordance with ECB TS6 Guidance. The non-turf wickets shall remain in existence and available or use for as long as the development herby permitted remains in existence.

Condition : 9 - All removal of trees, hedgerows, shrubs, scrub or tall herbaceous vegetation, or clearance of any potential bird nesting habitats, shall be undertaken between September and February inclusive. If this is not possible then a suitably qualified ecologist shall check the areas concerned immediately prior to the clearance works to ensure that no nesting or nest-building birds are present. If any nesting birds are present then the vegetation shall not be removed until the fledglings have left the nest.
